name: Giuliana Caprotti
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Giuliana Caprotti inherited her fortune from her late husband Bernardo Caprotti, who was the founder of Italian supermarket chain Esselunga.
Bernardo left his second wife Giualiana and their daughter Marina a 67% stake in the company, and gave the remaining third to his other two children.
In 2020, Giuliana and Marina bought out the remaining stake of Esselunga for nearly 2 billion Euros.
Giuliana was named honorary chair of Esselunga in 2020.

name: Orion Hindawi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2019-2020); Wikidata (2021); Hurun Unicorn founders (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Orion Hindawi cofounded cybersecurity firm Tanium with his father David in 2007; private investors valued the firm at $9 billion in June 2020.
In February 2016, Orion took over as CEO of Tanium from his father, who serves as executive chairman.
The father-son team previously worked together on BigFix, an IT software patching system that they sold to IBM for $400 million in 2010.
Orion's father David was born in Baghdad, grew up in Israel, and went to UC Berkeley to earn a Ph.D.
Orion also ended up at UC Berkeley in 1997, but dropped out before graduating to work with his father.

name: Ni Zhaoxing

forbes_bio: Ni Zhaoxing chairs Zhongrong International Holdings Group, a private company active in real estate, energy and art.
Ni bought cheaply into Shanghai's Pudong district in the 1990s and built office towers there.
He is currently focused on promoting Chang'an No. 1, which boasts 78 European-style villas in a western Beijing mountain landscape.

name: Mark Jones
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023-2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Mark Jones is cofounder and executive chairman of Goosehead Insurance.
Jones was a truck driver before getting an MBA from Harvard and landing a consulting job at Bain.
He married Robyn Jones, his teenage sweetheart, right out of high school, and she raised the couple's six kids while he went to school and worked.
Frustrated with Mark's road warrior lifestyle, Robyn started a property and casualty insurance agency in 2003. Mark left Bain in 2004 to join her.
They took Goosehead public in 2018. The Jones family owns more than a third of the $315 million (2024 revenue) business, which has more than 1,000 franchises.
forbes_facts: Goosehead Insurance is named after Jones' granddaughter Lucy "Goosehead" Langston.

name: Venkateswarlu Jasti
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019)
forbes_bio: Gets wealth from the sale of a substantial stake in listed Suven Pharmaceuticals in 2022 to global private equity firm Advent International.
He cofounded Suven Pharma with his wife Sudharani in 1989.
He is  chairman and Chief Executive of Suven Life Sciences which he cofounded in 1989.
The Hyderabad company was demerged in 2020 when Suven Life Sciences, which focuses on neuroscience therapies, was spun off and listed separately.
forbes_facts: Her son Venkateswarlu Jasti ran a chain six of community pharmacies in the states of New York and New Jersey in the U.S. in the 1970s and 1980s.
